subject: Next steps: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and trust portal access
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + immediate asks (SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, VSQ)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align with your security team: 

- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood has a Type II report for the period ending 2026-06-30. We can share the report under NDA/portal access.
- Bridge letter: We can provide a bridge letter that covers interim controls through the current quarter while the next audit is in progress.
- Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): I attached our VSQ answers template — please let me know if you prefer we fill your vendor form directly.
- Trust portal: We will provision temporary read-only access to our Trust Portal (evidence repository) for Harbor Health.

Immediate asks from your side: 
1) Can your team sign the mutual NDA (I can send a DocuSign link) or confirm that portal access under your existing NDA is fine?
2) Who should I add to the Trust Portal (name + email + role)?
3) Any specific scope items (HIPAA / GDPR clauses) you want called out in the bridge letter?

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Bridge_Letter_2026-06.pdf (draft), Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_HarborHealth_filled.pdf (blank template)

I looped in Ben (AM) and Karthik (Security) to keep them in the loop for provisioning and technical questions. Proposed timeline: portal access + bridge letter within 48 hours after NDA, VSQ back within 2 business days.

Thanks —

Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192 | tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from our side:

- NDA: Harbor Health already has a standing mutual NDA with Redwood (signed 2025-11-20). Please proceed to grant portal access under that NDA.
- Portal users: please invite myself (elena@harborhealth.com), Thomas Lee (thomas.lee@harborhealth.com), and our security manager Priya Desai (priya.desai@harborhealth.com). Priya should have read-only access.
- HIPAA: we need the bridge letter to explicitly reference PHI handling controls and the Data Processing Addendum (DPA) compliance stance; GDPR is not relevant to this scope.
- VSQ: We'll attach our vendor questionnaire (PDF) to this thread — we'd prefer Redwood fills our form directly.

Can you also include a temporary attestation covering control changes since 2026-06? We need that for our procurement review which is scheduled on Friday (2026-08-28).

Thanks,

Thanks for the details. Action items from Security:
